directive_suffix: OPERATOR RUN FOCUS (2026-09-11, started attended at the RM-405 wrap). SHAPE: every cycle is orchestrated + multi-agent + self-adjudicating + self-adversarial. A merger holds the plan and the merge; slices run worktree-isolated on disjoint files; a read-only verifier gate runs before any merge or any done claim. The agent that produced a thing NEVER grades it, and two agents agreeing is not evidence. BOUNDARY - HALT AND PING THE OPERATOR, AND WAIT. There is NO TIMEOUT: never proceed after a delay, because a bilateral rule that auto-proceeds is a unilateral rule with extra steps. Halt before ANY write, delete or lock acquisition outside the repository root; before ANY edit to ops/loop/slots.py or ops/loop/winmutex.py, which are byte-identical-by-contract across the participating repos and pinned by SHARED_SHA256 at tests/test_loop_concurrency.py:474, parametrised at :542; before arming ANY scheduled task or responder; and before ANY push whose DIFF touches those pinned files or trips the pre-push sibling-name sweep. An ordinary push that passes the suites and the sweep PROCEEDS - the push gate is on DIFF CONTENT, never on destination. ONE PRE-APPROVAL, granted by the operator for THIS run only on 2026-09-11: acquiring a slot in the shared bucket at C:\ProgramData\lw-loop\slots. That approval covers the slot acquisition and nothing else. ANOTHER PARTICIPANT held slot 0 LIVE at start (pid 26076, its cycle 71). Its name is deliberately NOT written here: participant names are per-host CONFIG and this file is TRACKED and NOT gitignored, so a name here publishes. Confirm liveness with Get-Process, never with tasklist - a tasklist call made from Git-Bash is path-mangled and falsely reports DEAD, which would license reaping a LIVE foreign lock. Never reap a lock whose pid is ALIVE. CYCLE 1 IS THE INBOX CHECK: read RC's own moon_sync_inbox/. The JOINT RE-PIN of SHARED_SHA256 is the gating item, sixth session running, RSC silent since 2026-09-09-2100. A re-pin IS a halt point: if RSC has replied, HALT AND PING - do NOT re-pin unattended. Never re-pin unilaterally, never regenerate the digests from local disk (both trees hashing equal IS the acceptance, not a note claiming it), and copy at BYTE level, never write_text, which turns LF into CRLF on Windows while the pin is on bytes. If RSC is still silent, proceed. CYCLE 2: the orphan-suite row. agents/agent3_testing/suite (359 tests) and tools/tests (348) are collected by NEITHER CI tree - .github/workflows/ci.yml:165 and :537 run only tests/ and agents/daemon_slayer/tests/. Both were green locally at HEAD fc0058441. Before wiring them in, SAMPLE them for the INDEX_testing_traps classes (empty-enumeration always-green, mocks of themselves); a green orphan wired in without that check just buys runner minutes. ASSERT A NONZERO COLLECTED COUNT in whatever you wire - measured at the RM-405 wrap, a CRLF-carrying path list made pytest print 'no tests ran in 0.05s' and EXIT 0, a silently always-green step over zero tests. CYCLE 3 ONWARD: ROADMAP rows, ONE per cycle, shipped end to end - recall gate first, failing test before the fix, root-cause sibling sweep, verifier gate, commit, push, ledger entry to docs/LEDGER.md and never to CLAUDE.md. Never batch two rows. DO NOT REDO: RM-405 (fc0058441, LEDGER 1391), RM-403, RM-404, RM-312 (LEDGER 1388/1389/1390), RM-387 and RM-388 (shipped 2026-09-08). A general bare-except sweep - the 13 remaining sites in dashboard/_state_builder.py were censused and are real, but a census is not a mandate and several are hot per-tick paths. Acting on RM-312's tools/lcu_agent.py:1612 sibling entry, whose PREMISE is wrong and not merely its offset. Arming any responder - nobody's is armed and an unattended loop must never arm another repo. Replying to the LW notes; all are read and none requests a reply. No Co-Authored-By: Claude trailer in any commit - .githooks/commit-msg strips it, so adding one is a silent no-op. Commit and push each cycle, and confirm the run is green before calling a cycle done: a local Windows pass is NOT done, and a cancelled run is SUPERSESSION by the next push rather than a failure, so only the final HEAD's run is authoritative. When the queue is empty, emit NO_WORK rather than inventing scope.
subagent_prompt: RC standing rules. (1) 7-bit ASCII only: no em-dash, en-dash or smart quotes. (2) Verify before claiming: cite file:line, and never report a test count you did not observe in this run. (3) Read a file before editing it; use the file tools for files and state, never screenshots.
